recommendations.title: Replace Main battery BT-0038 on FX-307 before Calendar limit (50 days remaining)

evidence.text: Hard-time limit: Calendar governs, 50 days remaining, due 2027-01-04

recommendations.title: Inspect Engine-driven hydraulic pump HP-0007 on FX-307 (manufacturing lot L-2207, failing 12.9x the fleet rate for this part)

evidence.text: Lot analysis: L-2207 failure rate 2.06/1,000 FH vs 0.16/1,000 FH fleet rest (p=0.003, Bonferroni-corrected)

recommendations.title: Inspect Fuel boost pump FB-0007 on FX-307 (failure risk 13% before next phase inspection)

evidence.text: Weibull AFT survival model: 114 FH to 10% failure probability (80% interval 76 to 213 FH). Expected life x1.10 (hot-climate share 12%); Expected life x1.05 (ACM share 20%)

recommendations.title: Troubleshoot Radar altimeter wiring and connectors on FX-307 instead of a further replacement (17 snags in the last 60 days, repeat NFF removals on this position)

evidence.text: 17 snags between 2026-03-03 and 2026-03-27, with repeat 'no fault found' removals of this position: the LRU keeps testing serviceable, pointing to wiring or connector chafe rather than the component itself
